name: High Moors
description: Chilly highlands where a large, grassy, cracked hill stands.

timeline.summary: Two Red Wizards of Thay undertake a secret mission into the High Moors, escorted by mercenaries who think they should be stopped.
timeline.quote: Two Red Wizards of Thay have undertaken a secret mission into the High Moors east of the Sword Coast.

timeline.summary: Pursuing the wizards leads the adventurers to a barrow mound where a wizards' sanctum is being plundered.
timeline.quote: At the barrow, they discover the remnants of a wizards' sanctum still being plundered.

timeline.summary: A vault in a cracked hill was turned into a prison as punishment for the souls who vowed to defend it and failed.
timeline.quote: It is a vault turned into a prison as punishment for the poor souls who vowed to defend it

timeline.summary: Someone must venture inside to learn secrets that could destroy an artifact that may already be in the wrong hands.
timeline.quote: The artifact could already be in the wrong hands.

relations.note: The barrow stands in the wild grasses of the High Moors.
relations.quote: a barrow mound in the wild grasses of the High Moors

relations.note: The hill stands in the High Moors.
relations.quote: A large, grassy hill stands in the High Moors, cracked by some ancient stress.

relations.note: The adventure around the lake is set in the High Moors.
relations.quote: the chilly, grassy highlands where this adventure is set

pages_say.description: Cold, windswept hills east of the Sword Coast in Faerun where the Red Wizards search and a barrow mound stands.
